diseases.name: Wheat Rust (Leaf Rust)
diseases.symptoms: Orange-brown pustules on leaves, yellowing, reduced grain fill.
diseases.causes: Puccinia fungus spread by wind-borne spores in humid, warm conditions.
diseases.preventive_measures: Use resistant varieties, proper spacing, avoid excess nitrogen.
diseases.control_measures: Apply approved fungicides per local expert guidance; rotate crops.

diseases.name: Rice Blast
diseases.symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with grey centres on leaves; neck blast on panicles.
diseases.causes: Magnaporthe oryzae fungus; high humidity and excess nitrogen encourage it.
diseases.preventive_measures: Resistant cultivars, balanced fertilization, avoid dense planting.
diseases.control_measures: Apply recommended fungicides early; consult local officer.

diseases.name: Tomato Late Blight
diseases.symptoms: Dark water-soaked spots on leaves/stems; white fungal growth in wet weather.
diseases.causes: Phytophthora infestans; spreads rapidly in cool, wet conditions.
diseases.preventive_measures: Good air circulation, avoid overhead watering, remove infected plants.
diseases.control_measures: Approved copper-based/systemic fungicides; destroy infected debris.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
diseases.symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves, curling, stunted growth.
diseases.causes: Various fungi; warm days, cool nights, high humidity.
diseases.preventive_measures: Improve airflow, resistant varieties, avoid excess shade.
diseases.control_measures: Sulfur or potassium bicarbonate treatments; prune affected parts.

diseases.name: Cotton Boll Rot
diseases.causes: Fungal/insect complex; trapped moisture in bolls.
diseases.preventive_measures: Timely harvest, avoid canopy moisture, pest monitoring.
diseases.control_measures: Remove infected bolls; follow local IPM practices.

pests.name: Aphid
pests.symptoms: Clusters of small soft-bodied insects, sticky honeydew, curling leaves.
pests.prevention: Encourage natural predators, early monitoring, avoid over-fertilizing.
pests.control: Blast with water, neem-based sprays or approved insecticides per label.

pests.name: Cotton Bollworm
pests.symptoms: Holes in bolls/fruits, frass, wilting of damaged parts.
pests.prevention: Scouting, trap crops, pheromone traps, crop rotation.
pests.control: Approved insecticides at egg stage; follow local spray schedule.

pests.name: Fall Armyworm
pests.symptoms: Ragged feeding on leaves, frass, seedling damage.
pests.control: Hand-pick egg masses, recommended biological/integrated controls.

pests.name: Brown Plant Hopper
pests.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen, proper water management, resistant varieties.

pests.name: Whitefly
pests.symptoms: White winged insects under leaves, honeydew, sooty mould.
pests.prevention: Yellow sticky traps, reflective mulch, remove infested leaves.
pests.control: Neem-based sprays or approved insecticides; rotate product classes.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Income support of Rs. 6000/year to eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.eligibility: Small & marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding as per scheme criteria.
schemes.benefits: Direct transfer of Rs. 6000 per year in three instalments.
schemes.documents_required: Land records, bank account details, Aadhaar.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online through the PM-KISAN portal; details verified by state.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance against unforeseen crop loss due to natural calamities/pests.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
schemes.benefits: Insurance coverage at low premium; subsidy on premium.
schemes.documents_required: Land records, bank details, sowing details.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through banks/insurance companies before the cut-off date.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / RBI
schemes.description: Short-term credit for farmers for cultivation and other farm needs.
schemes.benefits: Affordable working capital credit with interest subvention.
schemes.documents_required: Identity proof, land/tenancy records, bank details.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch; issuance subject to bank eligibility.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides soil nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations.
schemes.benefits: Soil testing and recommendations to improve productivity.
schemes.how_to_apply: Sample collection by department; card issued periodically.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
schemes.description: Enhances irrigation efficiency and water conservation.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers and farm groups in project areas.
schemes.benefits: Support for micro-irrigation and assured irrigation.
